notes.title: Shroomtopia in the Made in Brazil Sale with a DEMO!!! 🍄🌿
notes.content:
✨ Hey everyone! ✨

From today until March 4th, Shroomtopia is part of Steam's Made in Brazil Sale! 🎮🇧🇷

To celebrate the festival, we are releasing a playable demo, allowing you to experience a bit of this atmospheric and relaxing journey before launch! 🌱✨

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2483440/Shroomtopia/

Shroomtopia is a cozy indie puzzle game, where you manipulate soil and mix colors to solve challenges and restore nature. Relax with serene music, a charming visual style, and gameplay that fosters creativity and tranquility.


 🍄 Explore a vibrant world inspired by the beauty of nature.
 🎨 Mix colors and restore balance to the ecosystem.
 🧩 Solve creative puzzles based on biomes and terrain.
 🎶 Relaxing soundtrack, perfect for unwinding and enjoying the journey.
 🌎 Discover hidden secrets and bring life back to the environment.

Download the demo and chill 💚

notes.title: Announcement - Steam Next Fest Feedback
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We are thrilled with the community's interest in Shroomtopia!

Participating in the Steam Next Fest was crucial in increasing our visibility and gathering valuable feedbacks.

We still have many things to do to make our game even better, and we would like to share a bit more with you.

New features added to our roadmap

Portal mechanic
This mechanic was designed to add more uniqueness and variation to Shroomtopia's gameplay. It allows the transport of the nectar of life from one place to any other on the map, opening up a wide range of new challenges for the player.

Level skip
We understand that each player has a different way of thinking, and giving the freedom to skip a level and continue progressing can be very valuable.

Level selector
We need to make it easier to access levels during the game. Advancing one by one can become tedious if the player is trying to access a distant level.

Important revisions

Level design
We need to be more direct in each level's challenge and reduce the number of unnecessary steps to solve them. We will also utilize the color mixing and portal mechanics more, making this revision even more crucial.

Soundtrack and sound effects
Feedback on the music has been very positive, but we understand that an atmospheric game needs a bit more shine in its sound effects. We will revisit these points to bring an even better experience to the game.

Release date
Our release date is being postponed to Q2 2025. We want to launch a high-quality game and will spare no effort to achieve that.

We will continue to update our demo frequently so that new feedback can be collected.

Thank you very much, everyone!

notes.title: Shroomtopia Demo Update - Patch notes
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We would like to announce that the first update to the Shroomtopia Demo is now live, with many improvements and refinements based on your feedback. Thank you all very much for contributing to the creation of this game!

Demo Update – Patch notes


 Lots of performance inprovements!
 Added a subtle glow to the fertilizing soil.
 Added subtle highlights to some UI buttons.
 Added buttons to go back instead of having to press ESC every screen.
 Levels 8, 12 and 15 adjusted.
 Small visual bug fixes.
